title: Decision tree computes a function
statement: A finite decision tree $T$ with alphabet $\Omega$, labels $\alpha$, and available coordinates $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ computes a function $f:\Omega^n\to\alpha$ if evaluating $T$ gives $f(x)$ for every input $x\in\Omega^n$.
